section_path: REGIONAL LYMPH NODES FOR HEAD AND NECK PRIMARIES
text:
The lymph nodes below are regional for all Head and Neck sites (C00-C14, C30-C33) and include Single, Multiple, Bilateral and Contralateral lymph nodes.

Level I Prelaryngeal

Level IA - Submental Pretracheal - above suprasternal notch Level IB - Submandibular (submaxillary), Recurrent laryngeal sublingual Level VII - Superior mediastinal group

Level II - Upper jugular

Jugulodigastric (subdigastric)

| Upper deep cervical | Esophageal groove |
|---|---|
| Level IIA - Anterior | Paratracheal - below suprasternal notch |
| Level IIB - Posterior | Pretracheal - below suprasternal notch |

Level III - Middle jugular Other groups

Middle deep cervical Cervical, NOS Level IV - Lower jugular Deep cervical, NOS

| Jugulo-omohyoid (supraomohyoid) | Facial |
|---|---|
| Lower deep cervical | Buccinator (buccal) |
| Virchow node | Mandibular |

Level V - Posterior triangle group Nasolabial

Posterior cervical Internal jugular, NOS Level VA - Spinal accessory Parapharyngeal Level VB - Transverse cervical, Parotid supraclavicular Infraauricular Level VI - Anterior compartment group Intraparotid

Laterotracheal Periparotid Paralaryngeal Preauricular Paratracheal - above suprasternal notch Retroauricular (mastoid) Perithyroidal Retropharyngeal Precricoid (Delphian) Suboccipital
